name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and runs Nginx for three configured sites, including document roots, static content, SSL virtual hosts, and host and web-server security hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis with password authentication and logging, and cleans up replication-related configuration directives.
